purpose: Final scope-aware audit for MathBridge core research and release packaging.
completion_rule: A required item is complete when it is verified, explicitly classified as not publicly recoverable/query-dependent, or excluded/downgraded because evidence does not support the stronger claim. A coverage claim also requires every runtime-manifest file to physically exist.

china: Revised PEP primary mathematics sequence, unit mapping, evidence-level detail, artifact state and rollout model

china_locator_state.single_page_per_bullet: not directly renderable with current access; never fabricated

pep_state.below_unit_detail: stored where publicly recoverable and evidence-level gated
pep_state.artifact_identity: all 12 slots have explicit final state

classified_limits_not_blockers: Some revised PEP ISBNs are not publicly recoverable and are not guessed.
Later-semester revised PEP classroom artifacts are separated from authoritative designed sequence and rollout.
Local PEP use requires locality/publisher/term context.
Exact single-page China-standard bullet locators are not fabricated when the large official PDF cannot be directly rendered.
Probe-only diagnostic records remain instructional hypotheses rather than research-established misconceptions.
All US state curricula are outside the core scope; Common Core remains the explicitly labelled baseline.
release_rules: Never replace a classified unavailable value with a guess.
Never use legacy PEP data as revised-series data.
Never imply PEP is the single national Chinese textbook.
Never describe Common Core as the single nationwide US curriculum.
Never convert curriculum/guidance into national classroom-frequency claims.
Never present a diagnostic probe as a validated assessment or one-answer diagnosis.
Keep teacher-facing copy direct, educational and non-promotional.
next_action: Merge the tested static data-driven teacher interface to main and verify the existing Cloudflare deployment.
